job.title: Senior Full-Stack Developer
job.description:
### Join Our Team at Supreme Optimization

Are you a seasoned Full-Stack Developer looking to make a significant impact in the life science and biotechnology industry? Supreme Optimization, a leading marketing agency with a team of over 50 Ph.D. professionals, is seeking a Senior Full-Stack Developer to join our innovative team.

### About Us

At Supreme Optimization, we specialize in providing tailored marketing solutions to elevate the brands of life science and biotechnology companies. With a focus on supreme optimization, we are dedicated to delivering top-notch services that drive success for our clients.

### Role Overview

As a Senior Full-Stack Developer at Supreme Optimization, you will play a crucial role in developing cutting-edge solutions that integrate Node.js, Laravel, React, and more. Your expertise will contribute to the seamless integration of AI and ILM technologies, ensuring our clients receive the best-in-class marketing solutions.

### Why Join Us?

Joining our team means being part of a dynamic and forward-thinking environment where your skills and creativity will be valued. You will have the opportunity to work with a team of industry experts and contribute to projects that make a real difference in the life science and biotechnology sectors.

### Ready to Elevate Your Career?

If you are a Senior Full-Stack Developer with a passion for innovation and a drive to excel in a fast-paced environment, we want to hear from you. Take the next step in your career and join Supreme Optimization in revolutionizing the marketing landscape for life science and biotechnology companies.

job.title: AI Trading Developer
job.description:
### Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced **AI Trading Developer** to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in creating trading algorithms or utilizing trading systems. This role requires exceptional problem-solving skills and expertise in quantitative development to enhance our trading strategies and systems.

#### Responsibilities

*   Develop and implement trading algorithms to optimize performance and efficiency.
*   Utilize existing trading systems, enhancing them with innovative AI solutions.
*   Collaborate with quantitative analysts to refine and test trading strategies.
*   Analyze market data to identify opportunities for algorithmic trading.
*   Continuously monitor and improve the performance of trading algorithms.

#### Required Skills

*   Proven experience in developing trading algorithms or working with trading systems.
*   Strong problem-solving abilities and analytical mindset.
*   Expertise in quantitative development and data analysis.

#### Nice to Have

*   Familiarity with AI and machine learning techniques in the context of trading.
*   Experience with backtesting frameworks and financial modeling.

job.title: Quantitative Strategy Developer
job.description:
### Role Overview

We are looking for a **Quantitative Strategy Developer** to work on developing and validating systematic trading strategies. This role offers the flexibility to work remotely from anywhere, with a focus on strategy validation rather than fixed working hours. You'll be part of a team that builds and licenses trading strategies to retail clients using platforms like NinjaTrader and Charles Schwab.

#### Responsibilities

*   Port a defined trading strategy to NinjaScript, ensuring the backtest matches a Python reference implementation.
*   Develop a Python-based walk-forward validation framework to assess strategy performance, including in-sample vs. out-of-sample results and parameter sensitivity.
*   Document the validation framework for usability by other team members.
*   Engage in ongoing strategy development, contributing to the refinement and expansion of trading strategies across futures and equities.
*   Maintain clear communication and documentation to support asynchronous collaboration across time zones.

#### Required Skills

*   Proven experience in building and testing systematic trading strategies, particularly in futures or equities.
*   Proficiency in NinjaScript/C# for NinjaTrader 8 and Python for research, with familiarity in libraries such as pandas and vectorbt.
*   Strong understanding of avoiding overfitting through walk-forward analysis and proper out-of-sample testing.
*   Ability to model transaction costs accurately and discuss strategy capacity constraints and potential failures.
*   Excellent written English communication skills.

#### Nice to Have

*   Experience with REST APIs for broker connectivity on the equities side.
*   Background in discussing and managing regime dependence in trading strategies.
